naslov: Wizards take on the Pistons on 5-game skid
tekst:
Detroit Pistons (7-3, third in the Eastern Conference) vs. Washington Wizards (4-8, 12th in the Eastern Conference)
              Washington; Thursday, 7 p.m. EST
              LINE: Pistons -9.5; over/under is 221.5
              BOTTOM LINE: Washington enters the matchup against Detroit after losing five straight games.
              Washington went 17-65 overall, 11-41 in Eastern Conference games and 11-30 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Wizards averaged 16.0 points off of turnovers, 15.1 second-chance points and 45.2 bench points last season.
              Detroit finished 60-22 overall and 39-13 in Eastern Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Pistons averaged 117.8 points per game last season, 19.9 from the free-throw line and 33 from deep.
              The teams meet for the second time this season. The Pistons won 122-111 in the last matchup on Nov. 10.
              INJURIES: Wizards: Tristan Vukcevic: out (hip), Jamir Watkins: out for season (acl), Justin Champagnie: out (foot), Reece Beekman: out (shoulder).
              Pistons: Jalen Duren: out (hamstring), Isaiah Joe: out (hip).
